description: The Jellyfin Enhanced import on Bookmarks' settings page, in the je sandbox, run by bookmarks-je-import-probe.mjs once it has copied the synthetic 81-style Jellyfin Enhanced bookmarks in: Bookmarks' settings page, Data tab (a section in older builds). Before the import the section names the users who wait, Import is off and the switch-off checklist is replaced by the gate's line; the Dry run button posts dryRun=true and renders the server's report as text (the summary, a row per user with the same numbers as the API's own dry run, each user's errors in amber, the samples, Import enabled); Import posts dryRun=false, renders the applied report and reloads Diagnostics, after which the checklist shows (8 items, the shortcut steps last) and the line says what was imported. Nothing of the report is HTML.

steps.name: sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran
the gate before: JE users wait for the import
three JE users with bookmarks, all pending, the checklist closed
the API's own dry run, for the numbers the page must show
steps.eval: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Admin/Import/JellyfinEnhanced') + '?dryRun=true', data: '{}', contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' })

steps.name: open Bookmarks' settings page
the Data section: the import line names who waits, the gate's line instead of the checklist
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); if (!p) return false; const s = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportStatus'); const g = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeChecklistGate'); return !p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImport').classList.contains('hide') && s.textContent.indexOf('Not imported yet: the Jellyfin Enhanced bookmarks of ') === 0 && !g.classList.contains('hide'); })()

steps.name: what the section shows before
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return { status: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportStatus').textContent, gate: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeChecklistGate').textContent, items: p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksJellyfinEnhancedChecklist li').length, useB: !p.querySelector('#BookmarksUseBRow').classList.contains('hide'), dryDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeDryRun').disabled, applyDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeApply').disabled }; })()

steps.name: Import off before a dry run, no checklist and no Use B, the waiting users named (admin, viewer and the folder of no user)
open the Data tab and bring it into view
click Dry run
the dry run report
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportReport .bookmarksJeImportSummary'); return !!s && s.textContent.indexOf('Dry run, nothing was changed.') === 0; })()

steps.name: what the report shows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const r = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportReport'); const rows = (sel) => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(sel + ' tr')).slice(1).map(tr => Array.from(tr.children).map(c => c.textContent)); return { summary: r.querySelector('.bookmarksJeImportSummary').textContent, users: rows('table.bookmarksJeImportUsers'), samples: rows('table.bookmarksJeImportSamples'), errors: Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('.bookmarksJeImportError')).map(e => e.textContent), html: r.querySelectorAll('b, i, a, img, script').length, more: r.textContent.indexOf('And ' + __vars.dry.MoreEntries + ' more.') >= 0, applyDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeApply').disabled }; })()

steps.name: the summary is the API's numbers
steps.assert: __vars.report.summary === 'Dry run, nothing was changed. The import would add ' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Import, 0) + ' bookmark(s) (' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Detached, 0) + ' not in the library), update ' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Updated, 0) + ' and leave out ' + (__vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Duplicates, 0) + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.AlreadyImported, 0) + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Skipped, 0)) + ' (' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Duplicates, 0) + ' duplicates, ' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.AlreadyImported, 0) + ' already imported, ' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Skipped, 0) + ' skipped).'

steps.name: a row per user, with the API's numbers
steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__vars.report.users) === JSON.stringify(__vars.dry.Users.map(u => [u.UserName || u.JeUserId, u.Found, u.Import, u.MatchedById, u.MatchedByProviderId, u.Ambiguous, u.Detached, u.Updated, u.Duplicates, u.AlreadyImported, u.Skipped, u.Clamped].map(String)))

steps.name: the samples: 50, the unusual first, the more line, the error of the folder of no user, all text; Import on
steps.assert: __vars.report.samples.length === __vars.dry.Samples.length && __vars.report.samples.length === 50 && __vars.report.samples[0][4] === 'Skipped' && __vars.report.more && __vars.report.errors.length === 1 && /^No user on this server has the id 00000000000000000000000000000083/.test(__vars.report.errors[0]) && __vars.report.html === 0 && __vars.report.applyDisabled === false && __vars.report.samples.some(s => s[1] === 'Tears in rain' || s[1] === 'Bad item id')

steps.name: nothing written by the dry run: no runs, the gate still closed
click Import
the applied report
Diagnostics read again: the checklist shows, the gate line gone, the import line says imported
what the page shows after
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const r = p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportReport'); return { summary: r.querySelector('.bookmarksJeImportSummary').textContent, next: (r.querySelector('.bookmarksJeImportNext') || {}).textContent, snapshot: Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('p.fieldDescription')).map(e => e.textContent).filter(t => /kept as bookmarks-import-/.test(t)).length, keys: Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('#BookmarksJellyfinEnhancedChecklist li')).map(li => li.getAttribute('data-key')), adminText: (p.querySelector('#BookmarksJellyfinEnhancedChecklist li[data-key="ShortcutAdmin"] span') || {}).textContent, status: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeImportStatus').textContent, applyDisabled: p.querySelector('#BookmarksJeApply').disabled }; })()

steps.name: the applied report adds what the dry run said, a snapshot was kept, the next step is the checklist, the shortcut steps last (the key step in the words of the JE version's Keyboard tab: 12.11's Key field, 12.12's grid of keys), Import off until the next dry run
steps.assert: __vars.after.summary.indexOf('Imported: added ' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Import, 0) + ' bookmark(s) (' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Detached, 0) + ' not in the library)') === 0 && __vars.after.snapshot === 1 && __vars.after.next === "Next, switch Jellyfin Enhanced's bookmarks off with the checklist below." && JSON.stringify(__vars.after.keys.slice(-2)) === '["ShortcutAdmin","ShortcutUsers"]' && (await (async () => { const v = String(((await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics'))).JellyfinEnhanced || {}).Version || '').split('.').map(Number); return (v.length < 2 || v.some(isNaN) || v[0] > 12 || (v[0] === 12 && v[1] >= 12)) ? /Keyboard tab, click the key [(]B[)] at the left end of the Bookmark Current Time row, press another key combination, such as Shift[+]X, then Save Settings/.test(__vars.after.adminText) : /Keyboard tab, choose Bookmark Current Time in the list of shortcuts, type Disabled into the Key field and click Add/.test(__vars.after.adminText); })()) && __vars.after.applyDisabled === true && new RegExp(': ' + __vars.dry.Users.reduce((n, u) => n + u.Import, 0) + ' bookmark\\(s\\) here came from Jellyfin Enhanced').test(__vars.after.status)

steps.name: bring the checklist into view
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider while JE's Custom Tabs sync runs, excepted)
